releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.207: Adds two selectable Home Screen Widget shortcuts: Smart Search opens the existing notes search field, and Quick Note opens the existing blank note editor ready to type. All twelve shortcut routes, prior settings, 3D button feedback, text-size choices, responsive padding, and resize behavior are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 373: Fixes the Favourite Notes home-screen widget route so it opens the Favourite Notes list in the visible Diary panel, clears stale search/category filters, and restores the list to the correct container. Tapping an unlocked favourite note opens that note directly in the existing editor; note PIN protection remains enforced. Favourite and Pin remain independent.
